entities.summary: British, a notable figure in the history of Yemen, associated with 1962 Revolution and North Yemen Civil War (1963–1970). Preceded by South Yemen Independence and People's Democratic Republic. Their legacy influenced Last British troops leave Aden — People's Republic of South Yemen proclaimed and North Yemen under Saleh.
